;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)|Second Libyan Civil War]], [[2019 Western Libya offensive]]
**The UN cancels a planned [[Libyan National Conference]] that was due to take place later in April for negotiations between different political factions to organise [[2019 Libyan general election|new elections]] due to the ongoing fighting in [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/apr/09/un-postpones-libya-national-conference-amid-fighting-tripoli (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Sinai insurgency]]
**A 15-year-old [[suicide bomb]]er attacks a market in [[Sheikh Zuweid]], [[Egypt]], killing four policemen and three civilians, and injuring 27 others. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-04/09/c_137963410.htm (Xinhua)]
*[[2018–19 Sudanese protests]]
**Heavy gunfire is reported in the [[Sudan]]ese capital [[Khartoum]] as [[Rapid Support Forces (Sudan)|Rapid Support Forces]] loyal to [[President of Sudan|President]] [[Omar al-Bashir]] attempted to break-up an anti-government protest outside the military's headquarters, killing at least 14 people, including five Sudanese soldiers who defected to the opposition. [https://news.sky.com/story/sudan-unrest-14-killed-on-tuesday-as-anti-government-sit-in-intensifies-11689032 (Sky News)]

;Business and economy
*[[Debenhams]], one of the largest [[department store]]s in the [[United Kingdom]] which employs 25,000 people, collapses into administration. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2019/apr/09/debenhams-is-taken-over-by-lenders-mike-ashley-loses-sta (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Alcon]] has completed a 100% spin-off from [[Novartis]]. [https://www.pharmatimes.com/news/novartis_continues_to_reimagine_itself,_as_alcon_spin-off_completed_1284192 (PharmaTimes)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-alcon-spinoff-idUKKCN1RL0KH?edition-redirect=uk (Reuters)]
;Disasters and accidents
*A [[Japan Air Self-Defense Force]] [[Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II|F-35 Lightning II]] jet disappears from radar while on a training mission over the [[Pacific Ocean]]. Japanese [[Minister of Defense (Japan)|Defense Minister]] [[Takeshi Iwaya]] subsequently grounds Japan's fleet of F-35s. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/f-35-fighter-japan-missing-fleet-grounded-today-lockheed-martin-latest-updates/ (CBS News)]

;Law and crime
*[[2019 college admissions bribery scandal]]
**16 people are indicted on new charges in the nationwide college admissions cheating scandal, one day after it was announced that 13 of the defendants charged in the case would plead guilty for conspiracy. [https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/2019/04/09/actress-lori-loughlin-others-indicted-college-admissions-cheating-chase/J8ZGXQDIMyeP0vuNeKqxNP/story.html (''The Boston Globe'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/04/09/us/lori-loughlin-update.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[April 2019 Israeli legislative election|2019 Israeli legislative election]]
**Israelis go to the polls to elect the new members of the [[Knesset]] ([[Israel]]'s parliament) and a new [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-election/israelis-go-to-polls-in-referendum-on-netanyahus-record-reign-idUSKCN1RL00K (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**The [[Organization of American States]] votes 18 to 9, with six abstentions, to accept [[Gustavo Tarre|Gustavo Tarre Briceño]] as the ambassador from Venezuela. Tarre is the envoy from [[Juan Guaidó]]'s government; [[Nicolás Maduro]]'s Foreign Ministry calls Tarre a "political usurper". [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/oas-recognizes-opposition-envoy-as-venezuelan-ambassador/2019/04/09/7ffa3bb0-5b12-11e9-98d4-844088d135f2_story.html (''Washington Post'')]
